simple.name: Sacramental Time
simple.description: In your player profile, add the sacramental time.

simple.name: LDS account
simple.description: Get your member number with your ward clerk and create a LDS account, remember to keep your password safe! Afterwards, save the username on the player profile.

simple.name: FamilySearch account
simple.description: Access the familysearch account and create an account, preferable with your LDS account and then save the link/username on the player profile.

simple.name: Temple Recommendation
simple.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to request to get, to renovate or simple enter your temple recommendation due date on you player profile.

simple.name: Patriarchal Blessing
simple.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to request a meeting with the Patriarch of your stake in order to receive your patriarchal blessing. After you receive yours go to the player profile and set as received.

simple.name: Receive a Calling or Designation
simple.description: Have a meeting with a member of the bishopric to inform that your are willing to serve in the Lord's work here. After your receive a calling and/or a designation go to the player profile and enter it there.
